As requested here, subverse owners can now activate a new feature called "Anonymized mode" which converts the sub into a version of 4chan-like board where no usernames are displayed.

To be able to deal with spam, original usernames are still stored on WhoaVerse server, but they should never be displayed in a subverse where this new feature is activated. All comments and submissions made to a subverse with this setting activated will not show up on original author profile (comment or submission history).

When "Anonymized mode" is activated, voting is also disabled for both comments and submissions, although the voting icons are still there and behave as if they worked (this is something that can be tweaked later).

Once again, please test this out and report if you find anything.

Update: all submissions and comments sent to a sub while it was operating in anonymized mode are permanently flagged as anonymized and moderators can not do anything to see or force the username to show up.

Update 2: warning: once a subverse is switched to anonymized mode, it cannot be switched back.

TL;DR WhoaVerse subverse can now effectively be turned into a version of 4chan by activating the new setting "Anonymized mode".
